"""Actual official-host decode and display conversion; no geometry render."""
import bpy,json,hashlib,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('EVIDENCE_ROOT/houdini-blender-final/enhanced')
p=out/'denoised.exr';dest=out/'denoised-display.png'
assert p.is_file() and not dest.exists()
expected=json.loads((out/'verified_output.json').read_text())['sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
current=bpy.context.scene
s=None;im=None
try:
 s=bpy.data.scenes.new('HoudiniCrossDCCDisplayOnly')
 s.view_settings.view_transform='AgX'
 s.view_settings.look='AgX - Medium High Contrast'
 s.view_settings.exposure=0
 s.view_settings.gamma=1
 s.display_settings.display_device='sRGB'
 im=bpy.data.images.load(str(p),check_existing=False)
 assert tuple(im.size)==(1200,1500),list(im.size)
 pixels=np.empty(len(im.pixels),dtype=np.float32);im.pixels.foreach_get(pixels)
 assert len(pixels)==1200*1500*4 and np.isfinite(pixels).all()
 assert np.allclose(pixels.reshape(-1,4)[:,3],1,atol=1e-5)
 s.render.image_settings.file_format='PNG';s.render.image_settings.color_depth='8';s.render.image_settings.color_mode='RGBA'
 im.save_render(str(dest),scene=s)
 report={'full_exr_beauty_decode':True,'finite':True,'opaque':True,'size':list(im.size),'exr_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'display_png_sha256':hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'view_transform':s.view_settings.view_transform,'look':s.view_settings.look,'exposure':s.view_settings.exposure,'gamma':s.view_settings.gamma,'route':'official MCP host image.save_render; no geometry render'}
 Path('EVIDENCE_ROOT/houdini-blender-final/final_display_validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print(json.dumps(report))
finally:
 if im is not None: bpy.data.images.remove(im)
 if s is not None: bpy.data.scenes.remove(s)
 assert bpy.context.scene==current
